claims.label: PROVIDER_FACT
claims.text: Gateway route tables have routing constraints that must be considered when inserting middleboxes.

claims.label: ARCHITECTURAL_INFERENCE
claims.text: A middlebox design should be checked for symmetry before choosing gateway route-table insertion.
claims.inference_rationale: Routing constraints can invalidate an otherwise plausible inspection path.

content.problem_statement: Insert inspection into VPC traffic without violating gateway route-table behavior.
tradeoffs: Centralized inspection can simplify controls but increases routing dependencies.
failure_modes: Unsupported routing assumptions can cause traffic loss.
security_implications: Inspection placement must match the intended security boundary.
reliability_implications: Routing dependencies add failure paths that need validation.
cost_implications: Additional appliances or routing constructs can add processing/data-transfer cost.
decision_change_triggers: Change in traffic path or inspection architecture
